description: Call a published external API with one standard x402 payment for the total provider price plus 8% fee. POST input, inspect the 402 total, sign once and retry the identical body. A private random request_id is optional for recovery without a payment header. HTTP 202 means recover with the original payment or private request_id; never sign a replacement charge. Failed calls receive an automatic full refund. Legacy signature fields recover historical two-payment calls only. No buyer account is required.
name: speedbot_product_api_call
title: Product api call
